Type-safe window function helpers, frame specifications, and named window support have been implemented and committed on the `feat/window-functions` branch.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Function & Frame Builders ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts))**:
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L298-L300), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L302-L304), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L306-L308), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L310-L313), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L315-L317), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L319-L321).
   - **Offset / Value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L325-L364), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L366-L405), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L407-L411), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L413-L417), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L419-L428) — typed nullable by default, with `lag` and `lead` stripping `null` when a non-null `defaultValue` is provided, and emitting numeric positional arguments inline as raw SQL literals.
   - **Aggregate window helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L432-L434), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L436-L438), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L440-L447), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L449-L456), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L458-L463) (emitting `count(*)` when called with no arguments).
   - **Frame utilities & boundary constants**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L140-L142), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L144-L146), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L20), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L21), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L22), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L24-L29), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L31-L36), and [`WindowFunction`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L204-L232).
   - Re-exported from [sql/functions/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts), [sql/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sql/index.ts), and top-level [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/index.ts).

2. **Named Windows (`.window(name, spec)`) Across All Dialects**:
   - Added `.window(name, spec)` to select query builders and `WINDOW` clause compilation before `ORDER BY` in PostgreSQL ([pg-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts), [pg-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts)), MySQL ([mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts), [mysql-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts)), SQLite ([sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts), [sqlite-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts)), SingleStore ([singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts), [singlestore-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts)), and Gel ([gel-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts), [gel-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts)).

3. **Tests ([window.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-upjmi_sf/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts))**:
   - Added unit and type tests covering all window functions, frame specifications, boundary/argument validations, and named windows across all dialects.
